tool.name: CheckScriptToolParameters

param.name: in_toolbox
param.dialogReference: The .atbx toolbox to check. It is read only; the tool never changes it.

param.name: out_report
param.dialogReference: A Markdown file with one parameter table per tool (index, label, name, data type, direction, type) and its issues. Paste it into a README to document the toolbox.

param.name: issue_count
param.dialogReference: The number of issues across all script tools.

tool.summary: Lists the parameters of every script tool in an .atbx toolbox and checks them against each tool's script: every GetParameterAsText(n) or GetParameter(n) index exists, every input parameter is read, and every derived output is set with SetParameterAsText(n) or SetParameter(n). A parameter index that does not match the dialog order is the most common script tool mistake.
tool.usage:
• Works with linked scripts (Execution page, a script file) and embedded scripts.

  • Only literal indexes are checked, for example GetParameterAsText(2). An index held in a variable is not seen.

  • Model tools are listed with their parameters but not checked. Python toolboxes (.pyt) are not read; their parameters are declared in code.

  • Issues are warnings; the tool still succeeds.

dataIdInfo.idPurp: Document a script tool's parameters and check the indexes its script uses.
